headline: Grief 📖 Mommy Kouri DUMPS Fentanyl 💊🍹 on Hubby Hubby 😵💀
text:
Utah 🏔️ bereavement BADDIE 👩‍👧‍👦📚 Kouri Richins 😈💅 found GUILTY AF 🔥⚖️ of FATALLY 💀☠️ POISONING her hubby Eric with a FETANYL-LACED 🍹💊 VODKA SLAMMER 😵🚫 in March 2022! Jury 💼👨‍⚖️ deliberated just 3 HOURS ⏱️😂 before SLAMMING the gavel 🔨 on this Black Widow 🕷️🍑 who wrote a kiddie grief book 📖😢 'Are You With Me?' dedicated to her 'AMAZING HUBBY' 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦💕 – PLOT TWIST: SHE WAS THE PLOT 😱💣! 

Prosecutors SPILLED the TEA ☕🔥: Kouri racked up MILLIONS 💸😩 in DEBT, took out LIFE INSURANCE 💰🪦 on Eric like a boss, and was BANGING 💋🍆 a side DUDE 👨‍🍼 while plotting her getaway! Called 40+ WITNESSES 🗣️👀 including the DRUG HOOK-UP 👮‍♀️💊 who sold her the FENTANYL – she texted for 'Michael Jackson stuff' 🕺💊😂, got hydrocodone then UPGRADED to the lethal MJ OD vibes! Valentine's DINNER 💕🍽️? Hubby falls SICK 🤢, tells pals 'WIFE'S POISONING ME' 😱🚨 – two weeks later, MORE FENT 💊, then sandwich ATTEMPTED MURDER 🥪☠️ nearly croaks him before the FINAL BOSS DOSE x5 LETHAL 🚀💀! 

DEFENSE? ZIP ZERO NADA 😂🚫 – no witnesses, no testimony from the ice queen herself 👸😶! Cops called at 3AM 🌙📞, she 'found him COLD 🥶' after bedtime vodka – MEDICAL EXAMINER 📋🔬 confirms FETANYL OVERDOSE, 5X DEADLY 😵💥! Also GUILTY of FRAUD 🤑🔒 on insurance claims and thinking she'd INHERIT $4M+ ESTATE 🏰💰 to run off with affair bro! Prosecutor Brad Bloodworth 🩸💉 NAILS it: 'Wanted to DUMP Eric but KEEP HIS MONEY' 🍑💸 – no DIVORCE, just DIVORCE BY DEATH 😈🪦! 

Arrested March 2023 🚔🔒 – TWO MONTHS after dropping her 'HEALING' book 📚🕊️ for kids coping with loss, telling radio 'COMFORT FOR FAMILIES' 😇🤥 while her THREE KIDS 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 watch mommy go to SLAMMER for 25-TO-LIFE ⛓️🔒 on aggravated murder! Park City 🏂 ski mansion vibes turned CRIME SCENE 🩸🏠 – from grief author to fentanyl FREAK 😈💊, Kouri's the ULTIMATE PLOT TWIST like a true crime Netflix banger 📺🔪! Hubby suspected the BLACK WIDOW 🕷️ brew, but sipped anyway – RIP Eric, you sweet summer child 😢🍹💀! Prosecutors SLAYED 🔪🏆, defense GOOFED 🤡, jury said 'GUILTY BITCH' ‼️😩💦!
